what: Live club mixing for the FM-1: four layers (lead, chord, bass, drums) that play by themselves in 20 styles while you ride them live. Blend one style into the next, build with intros and break-build-drop arcs, edit steps or play a layer by hand. All synthesised but the piano.
author: delirioux
sounds: CC0: Kawai grand from Versilian Studios' VCSL; drums synthesized by Felucca's tools/gen_waves.py (Hügelton Sample Pack, CC0 1.0)
